searchText: Hi guys, I am obviously in the wrong place but need help working out what's going on with my EL / CL pair. I'm running teku / besu but am not sure where their discord is. Basically my CL to EL connection keeps timing out and reconnecting. Could anyone point in the direction of the right place to ask? I ended up in this discord server by following a link on the teku docs. You can find them here: https://discord.gg/s54RNYEp Thank you very much Daniel, much appreciated. https://twitter.com/hudsonjameson/status/1570127028887715840?s=20&t=z_Y4Mtua3ki-tUo6cBV9yw
